claim.quote: We find significant and systematic decrease of $R_{dAu}$ with increasing rapidity.

name: BRAHMS nuclear modification factors in d+Au versus rapidity

summary.plain: BRAHMS found that charged hadrons from deuteron-gold collisions are increasingly suppressed at more forward angles. The trend, stronger in central collisions, is relevant to whether gluons saturate in heavy nuclei at RHIC energies.
summary.technical: Transverse-momentum dependence of the nuclear modification factor R_dAu for charged hadrons in d+Au collisions at 200 GeV versus centrality and pseudorapidity (eta = 0, 1, 2.2, 3.2): a significant, systematic decrease with increasing rapidity, with mid-rapidity enhancement and forward suppression more pronounced in central collisions.

title: Evolution of the nuclear modification factors with rapidity and centrality in d+Au collisions at sqrt(s_NN) = 200 GeV
why_it_matters: Relevant to the possible onset of gluon saturation (the colour glass condensate) at RHIC energies.
